notes: The ASV recasts 'days upon the days of the king thou wilt add' as 'prolong the king's life': the fronted יָמִים is not contiguous with the verb so cannot fuse into prolong (rule 30) and goes unrepresented, על loses its relation (rule 40), and the construct chain יְמֵי־מֶלֶךְ carries the king's life with the possessive's the going to the rectum (rule 29). The distributive repetition דֹר וָדֹר rendered once as many generations is placed by rule 22's distributive paragraph: first occurrence takes the noun with its supplied quantifier, the waw and second occurrence unrepresented; fusing all three under rule 30 was considered and rejected because generations is a word spent on the noun itself.
